title: selinum tenuifolium var. filicifolium
intro: Selinum tenuifolium var. filicifolium, commonly known as Fern-leaved Lovage or Japanese Lovage, is a variety of plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine, valued for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, that may aid in reducing stress, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Selinum tenuifolium var. filicifolium include its ability to act as a diuretic, antispasmodic, and expectorant, helping to relieve symptoms of respiratory issues and promote urine production. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
